rows.evidence: RULE FOR THE PAGE (not a function; the same rule and the same 45 s as contract/bool-watchdog.mjs for combines and the holes group): sc.run is ONE synchronous wasm call with no cancel, so every groove runs in a Worker that is terminated at the budget and replaced; the student sees the sentence and nothing is changed. The static cost rule (G8) exists so the known slow classes never cost those 45 s; the budget is the backstop for what the rule cannot see. STATIC RULE vs MEASUREMENT (rg3-cost-eval.mjs, truck-only runs of every case with the cost rule OFF, slow = over 30 s CPU or killed at 120 s): fit set (fuzz seed 1) and HELD-OUT set (seed 2, never used to fit the rule), then the deterministic round-3 cases: records 120; scored 78 (skipped 42: no engine work or no features) | slow & refused 25 | slow & NOT refused (HOLES) 0 | fast & refused (over-refusal) 42 | fast & built 11 | max cpu of unrefused scored cases: 8.5 s | records 150; scored 101 (skipped 49: no engine work or no features) | slow & refused 28 | slow & NOT refused (HOLES) 0 | fast & refused (over-refusal) 63 | fast & built 10 | max cpu of unrefused scored cases: 9.1 s | records 88; scored 71 (skipped 17: no engine work or no features) | slow & refused 8 | slow & NOT refused (HOLES) 0 | fast & refused (over-refusal) 26 | fast & built 37 | max cpu of unrefused scored cases: 16.9 s. The rule has no holes on the held-out set and its largest unrefused run was under 30 s; the price is over-refusal (fast cases refused with the slow class, listed in each class row).
